Links: [{"title":"GitHub - henriquesebastiao/badges: 🎖️ A collection of badges for your projects README","url":"https://github.com/henriquesebastiao/badges"},{"title":"markdown-badges | The largest curated collection of markdown badges for your personal developer branding, profile, and projects.","url":"https://ileriayo.github.io/markdown-badges/"},{"title":"shields/README.md at master · badges/shields","url":"https://github.com/badges/shields/blob/master/README.md"},{"title":"Readme Badges GitHub: Best Practices | daily.dev","url":"https://daily.dev/blog/readme-badges-github-best-practices/"},{"title":"Adding badges to your README | egghead.io","url":"https://egghead.io/lessons/javascript-how-to-write-a-javascript-library-adding-badges-to-your-readme"},{"title":"List of Badges, in Markdown - Naereen @ GitHub","url":"https://naereen.github.io/badges/"},{"title":"github.com","url":"https://github.com/KeisukeYamashita/commitlint-rs/pull/325"}]

Based on the search results, I found relevant information about FOSSA badges in README files with the `type=shield` parameter.

A FOSSA badge in README markdown using the shield format follows this structure: `[![FOSSA Status](https://app.fossa.com/api/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2F[USERNAME]%2F[REPO].svg?type=shield)](https://app.fossa.com/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2F[USERNAME]%2F[REPO]?ref=badge_shield)`

The key components are:
- The image URL uses `https://app.fossa.com/api/projects/` with your project identifier
- The `?type=shield` parameter specifies the badge format as a shield
- The markdown link syntax wraps the image with a link back to your FOSSA project page

To add this badge to your project, you would go to your FOSSA project settings and locate the badge configuration option, then copy this markdown snippet into your README.md file. The format ensures proper attribution text for accessibility while linking to your FOSSA compliance status page.

content.text:
Your repo is already imported into FOSSA and public — I checked via the MCP server:

- Locator: `git+github.com/darthzen/fossa-mcp`, branch `main`, public, `latestBuildStatus: succeeded`
- Last scanned 2026-07-30, **0 issues** (licensing/security/quality)

So the badge will render green. There's nothing to enable — GitHub just renders `README.md` on the repo page, so "at the bottom of the repo page" means "at the bottom of README.md."

I confirmed the badge endpoint returns a real SVG (HTTP 200, `image/svg+xml`, 16KB) for your locator.

## The two badge forms

**Small shield** (conventional spot: right under the `# FOSSA MCP Server` title):

```markdown
[![FOSSA Status](https://app.fossa.com/api/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2Fdarthzen%2Ffossa-mcp.svg?type=shield&issueType=license)](https://app.fossa.com/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2Fdarthzen%2Ffossa-mcp?ref=badge_shield&issueType=license)
```

**Large badge** — the wide "License scan status" block people put at the bottom, which is what you're describing:

```markdown
## License

[![FOSSA Status](https://app.fossa.com/api/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2Fdarthzen%2Ffossa-mcp.svg?type=large)](https://app.fossa.com/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2Fdarthzen%2Ffossa-mcp?ref=badge_large)
```

The locator is URL-encoded in both: `git+github.com/darthzen/fossa-mcp` → `git%2Bgithub.com%2Fdarthzen%2Ffossa-mcp`.

## Getting it from the UI instead

Project → **Settings** → General; the badge markup is on the far right of that page. Same page has **"Submit badge PRs after import (public GitHub READMEs only)"** — turn that on and FOSSA opens the README PR for you on future imports.

Want me to add both (shield at the top, large block at the bottom next to your existing MIT/NOTICE material) and commit it?

Sources: [FOSSA Quick Import docs](https://docs.fossa.com/docs/quick-import), [FOSSA Documentation](https://docs.fossa.com/)

Add it to the bottom of README.md, then commit and push. [![FOSSA Status](https://app.fossa.com/api/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2Fdarthzen%2Ffossa-mcp.svg?type=shield&issueType=license)](https://app.fossa.com/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2Fdarthzen%2Ffossa-mcp?ref=badge_shield&issueType=license)
